headline: From ad leads to real buyers — a B2B snack manufacturer's content and lead engine.
summary: Meta lead campaigns with a self-filtering WhatsApp reply system, a lead-management SOP and tracker, social content and a cinematic product film for a bulk peanut and white-label snacks manufacturer.
channels: Meta ads, WhatsApp, IndiaMART, Instagram, catalogue
challenge: Ghanshyam Snacks manufactures bulk peanuts and white-label snacks for B2B buyers. Paid campaigns were producing a high volume of leads, but many were fake or low-quality, and the sales team was spending its day filtering rather than selling.
Alongside the lead problem, the brand needed B2B positioning, a proper product catalogue and consistent social content.

workstreams.title: Meta ads & lead generation
workstreams.text: Lead campaigns rebuilt with a WhatsApp first-reply system designed so fake leads filter themselves out before a human replies, plus a B2B reply template for IndiaMART enquiries.

workstreams.title: Lead-management SOP & tracker
workstreams.text: A five-stage pipeline — capture, 24-hour qualification, quote, Day 1/3/7 follow-up, weekly review — with an Excel/Sheets dashboard showing qualification rate, conversion rate, pipeline value and junk percentage by ad source.

workstreams.title: Social media
workstreams.text: 50-post content sets and reel production briefs so the brand's Instagram reads as a manufacturer buyers can trust.

workstreams.title: Brand & sales assets
workstreams.text: A product catalogue, B2B positioning material and IndiaMART listing assets built to the same visual system.

workstreams.title: Cinematic product film
workstreams.text: A sand-roasted peanut macro ad sequence — the product as the hero, shot to make a commodity look premium.

results: The lead pipeline now has a qualification step, a follow-up rhythm and a dashboard that shows which ad sources produce buyers and which produce noise. Figures for leads, qualification rate, junk reduction and conversions are published once confirmed from the tracker.

meta.title: Ghanshyam Snacks case study — B2B lead engine | gaa-tha
meta.description: How gaa-tha turned Ghanshyam Snacks' Meta ad leads into qualified B2B buyers with a WhatsApp filter, a lead SOP and tracker, social content and a cinematic product film.
